incidents.title: Owner portal entry — monitoring verification false alarm
incidents.detail: Owner-page monitoring verification recovered after correcting an obsolete HTML title assertion. The earlier failed validations do not establish an actual portal outage. Authentication and private workflows were not tested.

updates.detail: Two consecutive external page checks failed. The cause has not been established.

Cause identified: the monitor expected an outdated owner-page title. The assertion was corrected and deployed; the first verification passed. Monitoring recovery. Previously recorded failed checks are retained.

incidents.title: Property Team sign-in — monitoring target updated
incidents.detail: A single external reachability verification failed after the public /team/ landing page was retired. The monitor still checked the retired URL and page marker. Monitoring was corrected to the canonical /team/login/ endpoint and subsequent samples recovered. The failed sample is retained; authenticated sign-in, assignments, and private workflows were not checked.

updates.detail: One failed Property Team public-page validation observed. The underlying sign-in experience was not tested.
Monitoring configuration corrected from retired /team/ landing page to canonical /team/login/ sign-in. This is an approximate configuration-change time, not an independently measured service event.
Two successful monitor samples recorded after the corrected target. Earlier failed observation retained; no confirmed authenticated-workflow outage.

scope: External HTTP page reachability only; no checkout, availability, account authentication, or task workflows tested.
